name: Legacy Reward: Spectral Bear Cub
objectiveText: Completion Ah, the great <name> is back. Just as I expected. Why might I, Wiley, the humble innkeeper, expect the arrival of a specific adventurer? Because whoever your secret admirer is still hasn't updated your delivery address! No, no, don't say anything. We're all busy, I get it. Just make sure they get it sorted, alright? Here's your package. I am pretty sure whatever is in it is alive. Or was? At this point, I don't care to find out. I will forever remember it as being both alive and dead.
